data.revised_prompt:
Create a single high-quality 1024x1024 PNG-style 2D game FX animation sprite sheet. Exactly four equal cells in a 2x2 grid, each 512x512, but with NO visible grid lines, no borders, no labels, no text, no numbers, no arrows, no watermark. Entire background is 100% solid flat chroma magenta #FF00FF, including all space between frames.

Use the provided reference ONLY for Soft Candy identity/palette/glow/material: cute ocean fantasy, glossy translucent gummy material, lavender-blue gel, cyan inner glow, pink-violet rim highlights, tiny bubble beads, candy glints. Do NOT draw the jellyfish character, face, eyes, body, portrait, cards, UI, avatar, target, or creature anatomy.

Design FX-only compact local whip impact meant to overlay on top of a player avatar portrait. In every frame, draw exactly TWO short translucent gummy jellyfish tentacles. They are compact curved whip strokes with rounded paddle tips, semi-transparent glossy lavender-blue gel, cyan glowing core, pink-violet rim highlights, tiny bubbles, a few small candy glints. Cute, elastic, soft, damaging jelly ribbons snapping. They must NOT look like ropes, snakes, arms, claws, spikes, blades, lightning bolts, monster anatomy, or long horizontal tentacles.

Canvas layout: Top-left cell frame 1 wind-up; top-right frame 2 snap; bottom-left frame 3 hit; bottom-right frame 4 recoil/fade. Each frame centered in its own 512x512 cell, same visual scale, similar bounding box, generous solid magenta padding on all sides. No element touches or crosses any cell edge. FX occupies only central 60-70% of each cell, round/oval around center, not a wide side-to-side band. No projectile flight, no screen-spanning trail, no enemy-to-player connection.

Frame 1 (top-left): wind-up. Two small curved gummy tentacles curl inward around an invisible avatar center, one from upper-left and one from upper-right, faint cyan ring forming at middle. Compact circular composition, no long travel path.
Frame 2 (top-right): snap. Same two short tentacles whip downward and inward across invisible center, crossing near middle, bright cyan motion smears and small bubbles. Compact centered.
Frame 3 (bottom-left): hit. The two rounded tips slap the center simultaneously. Bright aqua-white soft impact flash, tiny violet splash streaks, bubble beads, circular ripple. Strongest readable hit frame, still compact.
Frame 4 (bottom-right): recoil and fade. Tentacles spring back into two short curved jelly arcs around center, fading cyan-pink afterimage wisps, bubbles, gentle violet ripple.

Polished clean HD 2D game sprite rendering, sharp edges, transparent-looking glossy gummy highlights over flat magenta background, ocean fantasy attack FX, consistent animation continuity across frames.
